// NOTE: This is a sample configuration file for filesystem storage
// USAGE: Copy relevant sections to your appsettings.json or appsettings.Development.json

FilesystemStorage.// RootPath: Root directory for all filesystem storage. In Docker, mount a volume here.
FilesystemStorage.// EntitiesDirectory: Directory for entity JSON files (relative to RootPath)
FilesystemStorage.// FilesDirectory: Directory for media files (relative to RootPath)
FilesystemStorage.// UseIndexing: Enable index files for faster entity lookups (recommended)
FilesystemStorage.// IndexFileName: Name of the index file in each entity directory
FilesystemStorage.// MaxIndexCacheSize: Maximum items to cache in memory (0 = no caching, trades memory for speed)
FilesystemStorage.// CompressEntities: Enable compression for JSON files (future feature)
FilesystemStorage.// PrettyPrintJson: Pretty-print JSON for easier debugging (increases file size)
